svg.aria-label: Two equipment racks: Rack A holds a Keysight N5182B signal generator, a Keysight N9020B signal analyser, a Pickering 60-103D-001 LXI chassis with two 40-785C-521 SP6T RF multiplexers and a general-purpose matrix, an SMA patch panel, the DUT and a DC supply and DMM. Rack B holds the out-of-band, instrument and DUT management switches, a console server, a VIAVI TestCenter SPT-N4U, a jump host and two PDUs.
